row:
Bloomington Wellness & Rehab is Minnesota’s #1-rated chiropractic and wellness clinic on Google, serving Bloomington, Minneapolis, St. Paul, and the Twin Cities for more than 25 years. 

Our 6,000-square-foot rehab and wellness center brings together chiropractic care, spinal rehab, MedX spinal strengthening, scoliosis care through Scoliosis Solutions of MN, neuropathy care through our Neurogenesis Neurovascular Rehabilitation Program, acupuncture, massage therapy, Aescape robotic massage, decompression, red light therapy, shockwave, Class IV laser, custom orthotics, functional wellness, telemedicine access, GLP-1 and peptide support, and remote functional medicine resources.

Led by Dr. Cory Emberland, our team helps patients reduce pain, restore function, improve mobility, build strength, and support long-term health naturally whenever possible. We create educational videos on back pain, neck pain, sciatica, scoliosis, neuropathy, rehab, wellness, and modern conservative care.
